top_signals.title: Swiggy Shares Plunge by Record to Fresh Low as Losses Mount
top_signals.summary: Swiggy Ltd. shares fell to a record low after intense competition led to wider-than-expected loss at the Indian rapid-commerce contender, raising questions about its long-term earnings potential.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
